decision.explanation: The question asks for the launch date of 'the Adriatic'. The provided documents describe three distinct ships sharing this name, which constitutes distinct valid namesakes rather than contradictory assertions about a single entity. D1S5 confirms the RMS Adriatic (1906) was launched on '20 September 1906'. D2S3 and D3S1 confirm the SS Adriatic (1871) was launched on '17 October 1871'. D4S5 confirms the Adriatic (1811 ship) was launched in '1811'. All three dates are supported by direct textual evidence in the source segments and represent separate historical vessels.
